feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 20 October 2026 11:46am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 20 October 2026 at 11:35am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds later.


##Synopsis##

Shallow low pressure over France, driving a front into the area, then another front moves in from the west tomorrow morning.


##Wind##

South or Southeast 3 or 4 occasionally 5, becoming Variable 3 or less in places this evening, then gradually increasing Northwest 5 to 7 in all waters overnight and tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate occasionally rough in the south overnight and tomorrow morning.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain, briefly clearing tonight, then further rain spreads from the west later in the night.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Northwest 5 to 7, becoming West or Northwest 5 or 6 tomorrow afternoon, then West or Southwest 3 or 4 in the evening. Further decreasing 2 to 4 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, occasionally rough in the south of the area at first, falling slight overnight into Thursday.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain, clearing to become mainly fair tomorrow afternoon. Further outbreaks of rain arrive overnight into Thursday.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain.
